items.distractor_fact: 同じ朝、別の温度計は{D}°Cを示していました。
items.gloss_en: That same morning, a different thermometer showed {D}°C.
items.entity_note: a different thermometer (instrument), not the first sentence's different observation station (place)

items.distractor_fact: 同じ日、別の証券取引所に上場するある銘柄の終値は{D}円でした。
items.gloss_en: On the same day, the closing price of a stock listed on a different stock exchange was {D} yen.
items.entity_note: a stock listed on a different exchange (place), not the first sentence's different company (organization)

items.distractor_fact: 同じ日、別の会社が運営するダムの水位は{D}mでした。
items.gloss_en: On the same day, the water level of a dam operated by a different company was {D}m.
items.entity_note: a dam operated by a different company (organization), not the first sentence's unspecified different dam (place)

items.distractor_fact: 同じ日、別の操縦者が飛ばした機体は着陸時に{D}mの高度を記録しました。
items.gloss_en: That same day, an aircraft flown by a different operator recorded an altitude of {D}m at landing.
items.entity_note: a drone flown by a different operator (person), not the first sentence's different drone (instrument)

items.distractor_fact: 隣の店のレジには{D}円が入っていました。
items.gloss_en: The cash register at the shop next door contained {D} yen.
items.entity_note: a shop's cash register (organization), not the first sentence's different customer (person)

items.distractor_fact: 別の顧客の口座では、同じ月の入金額が{D}円でした。
items.gloss_en: A different customer's account had a deposit amount of {D} yen that same month.
items.entity_note: a different customer (person), not the first sentence's account at a different branch (organization/place)

items.distractor_fact: ある個人の口座残高は{D}円でした。
items.gloss_en: An individual person's account balance was {D} yen.
items.entity_note: an individual person's account (person), not the first sentence's different company (organization)

items.distractor_fact: 近くの個人事業主の今月の収入は{D}円でした。
items.gloss_en: A nearby sole proprietor's income this month was {D} yen.
items.entity_note: an individual sole proprietor (person), not the first sentence's different shop (organization)

items.distractor_fact: あるフォワード選手は今シーズン個人で{D}点を決めました。
items.gloss_en: A certain forward scored {D} points individually this season.
items.entity_note: an individual player (person), not the first sentence's different team (organization)

items.distractor_fact: ある投資会社は今年{D}円の損失を出しました。
items.gloss_en: An investment firm posted a loss of {D} yen this year.
items.entity_note: an investment firm (organization), not the first sentence's different investor (person)

items.distractor_fact: 取引先の企業の工場では、今月の実際の生産数が{D}個でした。
items.gloss_en: At a factory belonging to a business-partner company, actual production this month was {D} units.
items.entity_note: a business-partner company's factory (organization), not the first sentence's unnamed different factory (place); that company's own target is not stated

items.distractor_fact: ある個人事業主の実際の売上は{D}円でした。
items.gloss_en: A sole proprietor's actual sales were {D} yen.
items.entity_note: an individual sole proprietor (person), not the first sentence's different shop (organization); their own target is not stated

items.distractor_fact: 別の気象会社が独自に集計した、同じ日の降水量データは{D}mmでした。
items.gloss_en: Rainfall data independently compiled by a different weather company for the same day was {D}mm.
items.entity_note: a private weather company's own data (organization), not the first sentence's different region (place); its own forecast is not stated

items.distractor_fact: 別のゴルフ場では、その日のコースレコードが{D}打でした。
items.gloss_en: At a different golf course, the course record that day was {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: a course record belonging to the course itself (place), not a named golfer, unlike the first sentence's different golfer (person); that course's own par is not stated

items.distractor_fact: この大会とは別のゴルフ場では、コースレコードは{D}打でした。
items.gloss_en: At a golf course unrelated to this tournament, the course record was {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: a course record belonging to a different course (place), not a named golfer, unlike the first sentence's different golfer (person); that course's own par is not stated

items.distractor_fact: 別の航空会社の便は、独自の基準時刻から{D}分後に到着しました。
items.gloss_en: A flight operated by a different airline arrived {D} minutes after its own separate reference time.
items.entity_note: a different airline (organization) with its own separate reference schedule, not the first sentence's different route (a different line/series); that airline's schedule reference does not apply here
